description: Phase 3: Offline RL — CQL portfolio rebalancer, RLHF alignment, SAC execution agent

userStories.title: CQL portfolio rebalancer
userStories.description: As the portfolio manager, I need an offline RL rebalancer using Conservative Q-Learning (CQL) that learns from historical trade outcomes without online interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/rl/cql_rebalancer.py exists with CQLRebalancer class
Implements CQL loss: standard Q-loss + conservative penalty
Trains on replay buffer of (state, action, reward, next_state, done) tuples
State: portfolio weights + market regime + recent returns
Action: discrete rebalancing decisions (HOLD, REBALANCE_10pct, etc.)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: RLHF reward shaping for trading policy
userStories.description: As the policy trainer, I need RLHF feedback integration so expert trader preferences shape the reward function.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/rl/rlhf_reward.py exists with RLHFRewardShaper class
Accepts pairwise trade comparisons (A vs B) from expert feedback
Trains a reward model to predict preference probability
Integrates shaped reward into PPO/SAC training loop
Fallback to base reward when RLHF data is sparse
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: SAC execution agent for order slicing
userStories.description: As the execution engine, I need a Soft Actor-Critic agent that optimally slices large orders to minimize market impact.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/rl/sac_execution.py exists with SACExecutionAgent class
State: remaining volume, time horizon, spread, order book imbalance
Action: continuous fraction of remaining volume to execute
Reward: negative implementation shortfall + penalty for high impact
Replay buffer with prioritized experience replay
